stem: When discussing prevention of avoidable treatment harm in paediatric asthma, which concern supports avoiding steroid overuse?

options.text: Bone health, growth, and behavioural change concerns

explanation: Bone health, growth, and behavioural change concerns support avoiding steroid overuse in paediatric asthma because prolonged or unnecessary steroid exposure can cause avoidable adverse effects.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because prolonged or unnecessary steroid exposure can affect bone health, impair growth, and contribute to behavioural change in children.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because persistent asymmetry on auscultation suggests an alternative respiratory problem, not steroid-related harm.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a harsh inspiratory neck sound describes stridor, which is not a consequence of steroid overuse.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because low-pitched stertor from nasal blockage is an upper-airway finding, not a steroid adverse effect.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because rhinovirus detection indicates a viral trigger or infection, not harm from steroid overuse.
